facts.text: Newington was officially incorporated on November 10, 1910, marking the town’s formal establishment in Screven County.
Every first Saturday of December, Newington hosts its Founders Day Celebration, a parade and arts‑and‑crafts festival that honors the town’s origins.
The Screven Motor Speedway, a local racing venue, draws enthusiasts to Newington’s spirited motor sports scene.
During the day, Newington’s town square buzzes with an antique car show, gun show, motorbike show, and a racing go‑kart event, offering a quirky mix of vintage and modern thrills.
Newington sits at 32°35′21″ N 81°30′16″ W, with Georgia State Routes 21 and 24 passing through the town’s center.
The town’s name honors its founder, J.A. Davis, who famously rode into town on a horse, spitting on the ground and declaring, “Here we shall build a town.”.
